passage:
A school used an AI interview tool to help students practice speaking. The tool asked questions and gave feedback on speed, clarity, and word choice.
Students who were shy found it easier to practice with a machine first. But the counselor reminded them that real interviews include emotion, eye contact, and unexpected follow-up questions.
The school paired AI practice with human mock interviews.
The tool helped students prepare, but it did not replace people.
Practice can begin safely with technology. Confidence must eventually meet another human being. Communication is more than correct answers; it is connection under pressure.
